product.title: Sagrada Familia Small Group Guided Tour with Skip the Line Ticket

description.text: Antoni Gaudí’s iconic cathedral, the Sagrada Familia, is the most popular attraction in Barcelona. Bypass the long lines with this skip-the-line guided tour. Stops include Sagrada Familia, Nativity Facade. Accompanied by a guide, head straight inside the modernist masterpiece to admire the stained glass windows and opulent ceilings, and view the exhibits in the museum, while learning more about the building and its renowned creator. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
